details: Bitcoin stabilized above $76,000 on Saturday after a recent selloff, but faced a significant test from continued withdrawals in U.S. spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs). Net outflows reached approximately $1.28 billion for November through Friday, with institutional investors showing a lack of sustained support and a broader technology stock selloff weighing on risk appetite.
title: Bitcoin Sees ETF Outflows Amid Price Stabilization

details: Bitcoin remained below $76,000 as Binance confirmed plans to close affected European accounts by December 31, following the expiration of the EU's Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) transition period. This move, impacting customers in France, Spain, Italy, and Poland, adds to regulatory uncertainty and comes amid ongoing security concerns in the crypto space, including a recent unauthorized access disclosure by Gnosis Pay.
title: Binance Faces EU Account Closures, Adding Crypto Market Pressure

details: The cryptocurrency market continues to show weakness in November 2026, with market confidence remaining fragile. Recent developments, including the U.S. midterm elections and the latest Non-Farm Payrolls (NFP) report, have made it difficult for confidence to recover. Cryptocurrencies are reinforcing their role as risk assets, exhibiting a strong positive correlation with the S&P 500, indicating that concerns affecting U.S. equities are spilling into the crypto sector.
title: Political Uncertainty and NFP Data Dampen Crypto Market Confidence

details: XRP's price faced headwinds as market participants raised concerns over the future of crypto regulation in the U.S., particularly after Democrats gained control of both houses of Congress. A Wall Street Journal report suggested Senator Elizabeth Warren is poised to chair the Senate Banking Committee, a move expected to lead to stricter crypto rules and consumer protections. This political shift contributed to a broader cryptocurrency market sell-off, triggering $22 million in XRP derivatives liquidations over 24 hours.
title: U.S. Regulatory Concerns Weigh on XRP Amid Political Shifts
